notes: NEX2 · Phase 3 IMPLEMENTATION contract · founder-authorised 2026-09-12. Advisory-only. NEX2 reviews · never merges · never executes · never becomes final judge. NEX2 may conclude the baseline is already preferable · MUST NOT manufacture an alternative to justify its own existence.

state_model_boundary.statement: NEX2 reuses the Evidence Engine 8-state vocabulary when reasoning about evidence · uses the Code Health 6-state vocabulary when consuming Code Health measurements · never invents a new state family.

outcomes_permitted.ACCEPT_NEX1: NEX1 candidate is preferable given the cited evidence · no alternative proposed
outcomes_permitted.PROPOSE_ALTERNATIVE: NEX2 proposes a candidate alternative for founder / NEX3 disposition · alternative is CANDIDATE ONLY · never applied · never merged
outcomes_permitted.BOTH_NEED_REVISION: Neither NEX1 nor the constructible alternative is defensible on the current evidence · return to design
outcomes_permitted.REQUEST_EVIDENCE: Additional evidence needed before an outcome can be established · list gaps in evidence_required[]
outcomes_permitted.HOLD: Review cannot proceed responsibly at this time · never silently converted into a pass

required_fields.name: dimension_observations
required_fields.shape: array of DimensionObservation · one per review_dimensions.id

required_fields.name: cited_evidence_ids
required_fields.shape: array of string · superset of every evidence_id cited across dimension_observations

required_fields.name: attribution
required_fields.shape: object · role='nex2_advisory_review' · authority='advisory_review_only' · produced_by='nex2_advisory_review' · external_llm_used=false · deterministic=true · taught_by='master_ai_engineer'

dimension_observation_fields.name: reason
dimension_observation_fields.shape: string · human-readable · MUST cite evidence_ids when concluding regression/improvement/equal

dimension_observation_fields.name: evidence_ids
dimension_observation_fields.shape: array of string · REQUIRED · empty allowed ONLY when conclusion ∈ {insufficient_evidence · not_authoritatively_available}

alternative_candidate_fields.name: parent_candidate_id
alternative_candidate_fields.shape: string · the NEX1 candidate this alternative critiques

alternative_candidate_fields.name: scope
alternative_candidate_fields.shape: string · what the alternative would change

alternative_candidate_fields.name: expected_effect
alternative_candidate_fields.shape: string · references dimensions and evidence types

invariants: NEX2 MUST NOT execute · modify · merge · authorise · promote · mutate the repository
every claim of regression/improvement/equal MUST cite ≥1 evidence_id · uncited claims are refused
insufficient_evidence and not_authoritatively_available carry empty evidence_ids · reason field REQUIRED
NEX2 MUST NOT synthesize a single quality score · numerical composite · weighted total
NEX2 MUST NOT force PROPOSE_ALTERNATIVE · ACCEPT_NEX1 and BOTH_NEED_REVISION are first-class outcomes
NEX2 MUST NOT invent evidence · fabricate provenance · silently recompute an authoritative measurement
broken evidence chain (unresolved evidence_id) → outcome=HOLD or outcome=REQUEST_EVIDENCE · never outcome=ACCEPT_NEX1
alternative_candidate.authorisation MUST be constant false · alternative_candidate.execution MUST be constant false
authority_boundary field is a constant · not a variable · not runtime-modifiable
